title: The Hummingbird and the wide-open district
summary: He describes the Hummingbird nightclub on Bienville and the lively district crowd, girls and pimps spending money.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: The hummingbird was on Bienville and Marie.
What kind of place was going on in that neighborhood?
Was it district wide open then? Yeah. This was 20 o'clock, December 20th.
Yeah that was in the 20s. That was around 28.
Around 28. Yeah. Things would jump on there.
Oh yeah. Wide open then. Everything. Gathering, district, everything. It was right down there in the district.
Did they have any girls turning tricks in the place?

There was a lot of dancing and drinking. The thing about it was when them girls come out of them cribs. They go home and take their bath and straighten their self up and put on them clothes. And come out there and just throw away some money.

And all them pimps they just come right along there and just burn up money. And I enjoyed when they get off too. I liked it. I liked it. See they wanted nothing for them to come up there and give you four or five dollars a clear number. Yeah believe me you said such a thing. Thank you. What you drinking? So and so and so. Here. Send the weed up there. They have a lot of fun like that. I didn't like that.
